spec_authority: XMODEM protocol (Ward Christensen, 1977) -- CRC-16/XMODEM as the standard frame checksum for XMODEM-CRC file-transfer protocol
reveng_entry: width=16 poly=0x1021 init=0x0000 refin=false refout=false xorout=0x0000 check=0x31C3

vectors.comment: empty input -- no bytes consumed, register stays at init=0x0000; xorout=0x0000 so result is 0x0000
single 0x00 byte from init=0x0000 with xorout=0x0000 also collapses to 0x0000
